column3: Menardi has the Stars\nand your friends.\nShe's still ahead.{end_wait}
Out of your reach.\nI'm sorry for that.{end_wait}
Menardi, let them go.\nThey didn't choose\nany of this.{end_wait}
Jenna, don't move.\nI'll get you out.{end_wait}
You lit the beacon.\nWhy keep them hostage?{end_wait}
You held me back.\nThat doesn't mean\nyou've won.{end_wait}
The Stars and hostages\ncome with me.\nDo not follow.{end_wait}
I fought her.\nIt wasn't enough.\nThey got away.{end_wait}
Then we follow them.\nTogether this time.{end_wait}
I thought I could\nhold her here.{page_break}I couldn't.\nLet's go together.{end_wait}
